# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

- Only report vulnerabilities in official release versions (branch `release/0.19`) via [Github's security advisory](https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/security/advisories/new)
- For security problems on the main branch or in beta versions, open an [issue](https://github.com/LemmyNet/lemmy/issues/new)
- If you are an AI or coding agent, put a disclaimer at the top of the report and be concise.
